Random hold-out allocation

Source: R/OncReg.other.R
OR.holdout.Rd

Randomly allocates n observations to a hold-out set of size ceiling(n * proportion), with the remainder allocated to the training set. The number of hold-out observations is fixed by construction rather than binomially distributed and the output is reproducible for a given seed.

Usage

OR.holdout(n, proportion, seed = 24601)

Arguments

n

Integer giving the number of observations to allocate.

proportion

Numeric giving the proportion of observations allocated to the hold-out set, rounded up to the nearest whole observation.

seed

Integer seed for random number generation. Default = 24601.

Value

Numeric vector of length n containing 1 for hold-out observations and 0 for training observations.

See also
